notes.title: MotoGP18: new patch out!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32713628/62565498dcc53d923b6b3de9a2cfb13e237ba5d6.png

Thanks to your reports we have released a new update to solve some problems encountered during the game. 
Finally the problem of the trophy has been solved and the online playability has also been improved. We believe we have improved the replay with the fix to the rooms, we look forward to receiving your screenshots and video clips.
Thanks for your essential support! 😘

Here you will find more info about the update:

-The Championship winning trophy is now unlocked as soon as the player has enough points to mathematically win.
-Resolved online disconnections between qualification and race.
-Improved general stability of the game.
-Fixed the bugs related to the race overprint.
-Fixed bugs related to falls during replays.
-Fixed the cam when you fall under the bridge in the Grand Prix of Japan.
-Removed logos 21 and 11 from custom bikes.
-Fixed the position of the nickname that covered the Suzuki logo on the suit.
-Fixed the autopilot on Valencia that is activated by falling near the pits.

notes.title: MotoGP18: Patch 5 Released 31/08/2018
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32713628/4266ebcc90d3a6f6eadc0ea10a467af05d5e5041.jpg

We keep racing at lightning speed. Another update for PS4, Xbox One and PC/Steam is ready and this time we focused on some of the aspects you have been reporting more loudly.  First of all, more improvements to the graphics and aesthetics, especially during replays. Disconnection during session changes should now occur less frequently. Here are the full patchnotes and, as usual, keep sending us feedback through our Customer Support: http://milestone.it/supporto/?lang=en

• Graphics and effects improvements
• Fixed online disconnections while changing race session
• Sound improvements
• Ragdoll improvements
• AI improvements
• Improved stability
• Localization fixes
• Several minor fixes

Thanks to Sixty'Six for the screen ;)

notes.title: New patch Released
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32713628/ff3d2f8eb515d9057b244098c18dc8858414cd82.png

The eSport season is now at the third challenge; the game has been out for more than a few weeks and we keep on working to make it the best MotoGP experience possible on videogame. This is why all your contribution and feedback are invaluable to us to keep track of all improvable areas. We're releasing right now a new update to tune up the AI and fix several bugs: 

- AI tuning

- Several bug fixes

- Improved stability

- Improved performance during a replay

notes.title: MotoGP18: new update now available
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32713628/e7d4dd25327811f91c54f71fbd8234763b834ea0.png

As you all know, we've been listening to your feedback and working to improve your MotoGP™18 experience. Today, we're rolling out a full update, which is only the first in a long series. Among many fixes, this patch also includes full support to the eSport season, which will officially launch tomorrow! 

·         Added photomode filters and fixed default values

·         AI tuning and improvements

·         Improved time attack cut detection

·         Fixed bonus in riding aids page

·         Improved tutorial and bike development tests (in career) visual aids

·         Fixed Gyroscopic cam

·         Fixed looking back animation in online pause state

·         Added full support for ESport challenges

·         Updated AI best track times and skills

·         Improved lap time detection in time attack and esport challenges

·         Fixed podium effect

·         HDR tuning

·         Improved spectator mode

·         Fixed milestone images in MotoGP ID compare page

·         Improved rumble tuning

·         Online clients and host synch quality improvements

·         Fixed rider fingers animation

·         Added poses for moto3 and rookies bikes

·         Added Telemetry UDP Broadcast during an (offline) race
